text: Attempt 6 begins. Every loan must pay for itself: loans only for districts that fill (~5,000 people each), infrastructure from cash, the loan guard never overridden except for fires, taxes 7% with the controller between 6 and 10, cash kept positive so fires can be fought. Fire rules from attempt 5 kept.

Attempt 6 started. Attempt 5 survived fires for 46 years but went broke, then lost 80% of the city to a 2048 fire it couldn't afford to fight. New rule: a loan must bring about 5,000 people or I don't take it.
Feb 2001: loan #2 for the 2003 district (homes + jobs).
Jun 2002: loans #3-4: coal plant + 19 north pumps, second coal plant + north job district.
Feb 2003: zoo from cash (home demand -618); finance ordinances + City Beautification.
